note: The passages name no civil registration system: they say legislation on civil registration and ID needs updating (May 2022), that sub-component 2.2.4 finances a national digital ID strategy and knowledge exchange on digital ID and civil registration, and that UNDP 'is set to focus' on sectoral digitisation in justice and civil registration that could reuse World Bank-financed shared infrastructure. Intentions only, with no system, office or method stated.
